definitions.explanation: A viral disease passed on mainly through the bites of infected animals such as dogs. It attacks the nervous system and is almost always fatal once symptoms appear.

examples.japanese: {狂犬病|きょうけんびょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧。
{狂犬病|きょうけんびょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{発症|はっしょう}する→発症する：22367_hasshousuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ほぼ→ほぼ：00109_hobo⟧⟦{助|たす}からない→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
examples.english: Once rabies develops, the patient almost never survives.

examples.english: If you are bitten by a stray dog abroad, you should go to a hospital at once, because of the risk of rabies.

notes:
{狂犬|きょうけん} (mad dog) + 〜{病|びょう} (disease).

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has had no domestic cases since the 1950s, but by law dog owners must register their dogs and have them vaccinated against rabies every year. Each spring, local governments hold group vaccination sessions (⟦{集合|しゅうごう}→集合：03068_shuugou⟧⟦{注射|ちゅうしゃ}→注射：01665_chuusha⟧) in parks and community halls.
